verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents some scheduling of specific accounting actions: Bill Pay lets users schedule vendor payments and 'executes your scheduled payments.' It also advertises automated bank-reconciliation workflows. The API surface lists Invoice Profiles, but the evidence never describes them as recurring, and there is no general-purpose scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: a documented general recurring job/workflow scheduler, explicit evidence of recurring (not one-off) schedules, API-level scheduling controls usable by agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
